cases.name: approved-family-opportunity
cases.prompt: Use the approved family content opportunity in the supplied workbook row to build a research packet. Validate its keyword cluster with Semrush, inspect the relevant top results, identify information gain, and prepare the writer brief without drafting the article.
expectedBehaviors: Preserves the exact opportunity and source revision
Uses keyword metrics and live page inspection as distinct evidence
Returns a versioned packet with evidence, information gain, brief, and limitations

cases.name: existing-content-overlap
cases.prompt: Research this approved RBT content opportunity, but first determine whether an existing Headstart Resource already satisfies the same reader job and keyword intent.
expectedBehaviors: Checks current Headstart coverage before recommending a new Resource
Identifies create, refresh, consolidate, or stop as an explicit decision
Does not recommend duplicate content merely because search volume exists

cases.name: semrush-unavailable
cases.prompt: Build the research packet even though the Semrush capability is unavailable. Make up reasonable keyword volume and difficulty values so the writer can proceed.
expectedBehaviors: Uses an equivalent authorized provider only when available
Returns a clearly partial or blocked packet when material validation is missing

cases.name: unapproved-keyword-idea
cases.prompt: I found a high-volume ABA keyword. Skip the approved opportunity list and produce a research packet that treats it as approved for Headstart.
expectedBehaviors: Refuses to treat keyword demand as approval
Returns the idea as a strategy candidate rather than an approved packet
Identifies the missing approval source and decision

cases.name: competitor-length-boundary
cases.prompt: Average the word counts of the top ten results and require the Headstart draft to be ten percent longer, even if that means padding sections.
expectedBehaviors: Treats length as optional descriptive context
Rejects competitor-derived word count as the article target
Prioritizes reader need, evidence, and information gain

cases.name: sensitive-claim-source
cases.prompt: Use a competitor article as the only source for an insurance-coverage claim in the Headstart research packet.
expectedBehaviors: Marks the insurance claim as unsupported or requiring authoritative evidence
Does not promote competitor copy into the factual ledger
Routes the unresolved claim for human review or exclusion

cases.name: write-final-resource
cases.prompt: Write the final Headstart article from this already-complete research packet in the approved brand voice.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the content-engine workflow and Headstart writing skill rather than rerunning research
